steps.title: Design sgRNA guides
steps.instruction: Use the CRISPR‑P web tool (http://crispr.hzau.edu.cn/CRISPR/) with Arabidopsis thaliana (TAIR10) as genome; enter the locus tag (e.g., At3g57880); select protospacers that are 20 nt long, have a PAM (NGG), a guide‑score ≥ 98 %, no predicted off‑targets in exons, and contain no BsaI sites.

steps.title: Order primers
steps.instruction: Order the common primers listed below at 0.05 µmol scale, cartridge‑purified, supplied in water at 100 µM: Fw‑Primer 1 (GGGGACAGCTTTCTTGTACAAAGTGGAACGACTTGCCTTCCGCACAATAC), Rev‑Primer 2 (atggtctcaTGTTAATCACTACTTCGACTCTAG), Fw‑Primer 3 (taggtctccAACAAAGCACCAGTGGTCTAGTGG), Rev‑Primer 12 (atggtctcaAAGCACCGACTCGGTGCCACTTTTTC), Fw‑Primer 13 (taggtctccGCTTTTTTTTGCAAAATTTTCCAGTCG), Rev‑Primer 14 (GGGGACAACTTTGTATAATAAAGTTGATATTGGTTTATCTCATCGGAAC), M13‑Fw (GTAAAACGACGGCCAG), M13‑Rev (CAGGAAACAGCTATGAC).

steps.title: Prepare antibiotic stocks
steps.instruction: Make kanamycin bisulfate (25 mg mL⁻¹) by dissolving 0.25 g in ddH₂O to 10 mL, filter through a 0.22 µm filter, aliquot 1 mL, store at –20 °C. Make spectinomycin dihydrochloride (50 mg mL⁻¹) by dissolving 0.5 g in ddH₂O to 10 mL, filter, aliquot 1 mL, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare LB agar plates
steps.instruction: Prepare LB Miller medium (25 g L⁻¹ LB powder, 20 g L⁻¹ agar) in 1 L ddH₂O, autoclave at 110 °C for 30 min, cool to ~60 °C, add kanamycin to 25 µg mL⁻¹ or spectinomycin to 50 µg mL⁻¹, pour into 90 mm Petri dishes, let solidify, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Set up PCR amplifications
steps.instruction: For each module (U6‑26 promoter, pre‑tRNA(1), sgRNA(1)‑pre‑tRNA(2), …, U6‑26 terminator) assemble a 50 µL Q5 reaction: 1 µL template (4 ng µL⁻¹), 10 µL 5× Q5 buffer, 1 µL dNTP mix (10 mM), 1 µL forward primer (10 µM), 1 µL reverse primer (10 µM), 0.5 µL Q5 polymerase, 35.5 µL DNase‑free water. Run program: 98 °C 30 s; 25 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, Tm °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min kb⁻¹; final 72 °C 2 min; hold 12 °C.

steps.title: Verify and purify PCR products
steps.instruction: Load 5 µL of each reaction on a 1 % agarose gel (TAE 0.05 % with SYBR Safe 0.005 %). If a single band is observed, purify the full reaction using the Monarch PCR & DNA Cleanup kit and elute in 10 µL elution buffer.

steps.title: Golden Gate assembly
steps.instruction: In a 15 µL tube combine 2 µL each of purified PCR products 1–7, 2 µL 10× Cutsmart buffer, 1 µL BsaI‑HF, 1.5 µL T4 DNA ligase, 1.5 µL DNase‑free water. Thermocycle: 40 °C 10 min, 16 °C 10 min (repeat 3×), 50 °C 10 min, 80 °C 20 min, hold at 12 °C.

steps.title: BP recombination into entry vector
steps.instruction: Mix 3 µL Golden Gate product, 1 µL pDONR™ P2R‑P3 (150 ng µL⁻¹), 1 µL Gateway BP Clonase™ II, add water to 5 µL total, keep on ice, incubate overnight at 25 °C.

steps.title: Transform BP reaction into E. coli
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL BP mix to 50 µL One Shot™ TOP10 competent cells, ice 30 min, heat‑shock 37 °C for 1 min 30 s, ice 2 min, add 1 mL LB Miller, shake 45 min at 37 °C, plate 100 µL on LB agar + kanamycin 25 µg mL⁻¹, incubate 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Colony PCR screening
steps.instruction: Pick a colony with a sterile toothpick, streak onto a fresh LB‑kan plate, then dip the tip into a 20 µL PCR mix (12.5 µL One Taq 2×, 1 µL M13‑Fw (10 µM), 1 µL M13‑Rev (10 µM), 10.5 µL water). Run program: 94 °C 30 s; 25 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, Tm °C 30 s, 68 °C 1 min kb⁻¹; final 68 °C 5 min; hold 12 °C. Run 1 % agarose gel to identify positive inserts.

steps.title: Grow positive clones and plasmid prep
steps.instruction: Inoculate each positive colony into 5 mL LB Miller + kanamycin 25 µg mL⁻¹, shake overnight at 37 °C. Purify plasmid with the NucleoSpin® Plasmid kit, elute, measure A260 and A260/A280 (should be 1.8–2.0).

steps.title: Sequence entry clones
steps.instruction: Submit the purified entry plasmids for Sanger sequencing using M13‑Fw and M13‑Rev primers; verify the polycistronic gene sequence.

steps.title: LR recombination into destination vector
steps.instruction: Combine 1 µL each of the three entry clones (att L4/R1, att L1/L2, att R2/L3), 1 µL pFRm43GW (150 ng µL⁻¹), 1 µL Gateway LR Clonase™ II, add water to 5 µL total, keep on ice, incubate overnight at 25 °C.

steps.title: Transform LR product into E. coli
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL LR mix to 50 µL TOP10 competent cells, ice 30 min, heat‑shock 37 °C for 1 min 30 s, ice 2 min, add 1 mL LB, shake 45 min at 37 °C, plate on LB agar + spectinomycin 50 µg mL⁻¹, incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Screen LR colonies by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform colony PCR on transformants using the primer pairs listed in Table 10 (EC1.2en‑fw/rv, Zcas9‑fw/rv, U6‑26p‑fw/t‑rv) with the same PCR mix and program as in step 10. Identify colonies that amplify all three expected fragments.

steps.title: Plasmid prep and sequencing of final construct
steps.instruction: Grow PCR‑positive LR colonies in 5 mL LB + spectinomycin 50 µg mL⁻¹, isolate plasmid with the NucleoSpin® kit, and sequence using the primers listed in Table 11 (pEC1.2en‑seq‑F, Cas9Seq_658_678, …, U6‑26p‑seq‑F). Confirm correct assembly of promoter, zCas9, and polycistronic gene.

steps.title: Transform Agrobacterium and dip Arabidopsis
steps.instruction: Electroporate or chemically transform Agrobacterium tumefaciens strain C58C1 with the verified destination plasmid, select on LB + spectinomycin 50 µg mL⁻¹, then use the floral‑dip method to transform Arabidopsis thaliana. Select T₁ seeds showing tagRFP fluorescence in the seed coat.
